name: Reign of the Pit
oracle_text: Each player sacrifices a creature of their choice. Create an X/X black Demon creature token with flying, where X is the total power of the creatures sacrificed this way.
blocked_sentences: Each player sacrifices a creature of their choice. Create an X/X black Demon creature token with flying, where X is the total power of the creatures sacrificed this way.

needs.what: a value reading the summed last-known power of every creature an edict sacrificed across a `for_each_player` loop -- e.g. a `sacrifice` `snapshot`/`as` binding that accumulates across iterations (as `mill`'s `as` does) plus a `power_of` form that sums a list of snapshots -- so one `create_token` of `demon_x_x_b_flying` after the loop can set power and toughness to the total
needs.why_existing_wont_do: The edict is `for_each_player` over `sacrifice` (Syphon Flesh's shape), but `op_sacrifice` overwrites both its `as` and `snapshot` bindings on each iteration, and `snapshot` captures only the first chosen permanent; `power_of` over an `as` list of oids reads 0 (and would read graveyard printed power, not last-known power). Creating the token inside the loop makes one Demon per player instead of one, and creating it first and adding +1/+1 counters puts the token in your own sacrifice pool and gives it counters rather than a base X/X
